answer: Before any attestation counts, a new agent must publish its funding graph and park 5,000 spendable coins in a time-locked harbor that releases only after two settled epochs. Admission is a narrow inlet: identities whose first credits share a parent wallet or a recycled work hash have that bond burned, not returned. Peer graders then etch matching confirmations into a public basalt record, and a claim is paid only when five established, non-kin signers agree inside the window. Isolated votes grant no seat, so a sybil swarm pays for bonds it cannot redeem.
